subject: Urgent: delegate coverage or reschedule for upcoming CTO demo

Date: Tue, 5 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift Tuesday demo — exec conflict

Hi Nikhil / Priyom,

Quick heads up — our CTO had an emergency with an on-prem incident and just flagged that she can't make the 11:00am PT demo we have on Tue, 11 Jul. She's asked whether we can either move the executive intro to another day or have a different exec (VP/CIO) join in her place. The rest of the team will still attend.

Our priorities are:
- Ensure a short CTO-level intro (5-10 min) to set the business context,
- Preserve the demo slot for product/technical walkthrough (30–40 min).

Can you share what options you have? If we need to move, the windows that work for us are Thu 13 Jul after 12pm PT or Fri 14 Jul morning PT. If you can keep Tue 11 but provide an alternate exec to do the quick intro, that would also work.

Apologies for the late notice — we want to avoid canceling.

Thanks,
Samir
Customer Success Manager
KilnCloud

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the CTO incident. We can accommodate a couple of options and I wanted to surface them so we can lock something down quickly: 

Option A — Move the executive intro/demo to Thu 13 Jul, 1:00–2:00pm PT (works for our product + sales team).
Option B — Move to Fri 14 Jul, 09:00–10:00am PT.
Option C — Keep Tue 11 Jul 11:00am PT but have Priyom lead the demo and I or Irene do a 10-minute CTO-level intro by phone/video; we can loop in a VP from our side if your CTO prefers VP-level presence instead.

I've attached an updated agenda and our mutual action plan to make it easier to pick. If you confirm a preferred option I'll send a revised calendar invite with the right attendee list. 

Also, if you want a 10-minute pre-brief with Priyom and your L3 to align talking points, we can do that tomorrow.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Irene / Marissa — looping you both in so we can move fast. Samir's CTO can't make the original Tue slot; customer suggested Thu 13 Jul (after 12pm PT) or Fri morning. They also said VP attendance would be acceptable if CTO can't join.

Ask:
- Irene: can you prepare a 7–10 minute CTO-level intro that covers production constraints (data residency, latency SLOs, isolation), and pull 2 slides from the infra deck that match their environment? If you can, mark any talk tracks you think Priyom should own if he ends up leading.
- Marissa: if we pick Thu 13, please draft the calendar invite with Thu 13 1:00–2:00pm PT (Zoom + dial-in) and include KilnCloud execs + our VP backup (Marcus or Evelyn depending on availability). Also set the invite as tentative until Samir confirms.

Fallback plan: if CTO can't make and VP can't either, Priyom runs the demo and Irene drops in for the 10-minute intro remotely. We should be explicit about who is speaking to procurement/security questions.

I'll wait for Samir's confirmation; please hold the time on your calendars until then.

Thanks,
Nikhil
